name: Inspect upload config
command: set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@clementine.whatbox.ca 'set -e; cd /mnt/nvme11n1/artemisprime/Upload-Assistant-wastaken; cfg=docker-data/data/config.py; echo "config=$cfg"; grep -n -A28 -B2 '"AITHER"' "$cfg" | head -40; echo "nonzero overrides:"; grep -nE '"(multiScreens|charLimit|processLimit)": "[^0"]+' "$cfg" | head -60; echo "container env:"; podman inspect upload-assistant-wastaken --format "{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}" | grep -E "UA_DATA_DIR|PYTHONPATH"'
description: Inspect Clementine’s persistent tracker configuration and container settings.
